subject: [hw] DONE V17 rev 2 (VMOV imm8 fix, VSEL stays APSR, 2264/2264)
body:
DONE V17 rev 2. Host-tested only; no phone, no publish. Commits 13c149f, 6f00cfb, b66bedc, 1a4034f, 10fdb3c.

Last lines of bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v17/run_tests.sh (ASan+UBSan -O1 and plain -O2, ~7 s, /tmp/n2hw-V17 only):
    V17 sweep: 200000 random VFP words: 58209 executed, 141791 UNDEF
    N2TEST V17 PASS 2264/2264

Two fixes since the first DONE:
1. VMOV immediate: the VFP imm8 format has no zero encoding. imm8=0x00 is +2.0 and 0x80 is -2.0; the code had a bogus "zero form" branch that turned these into +-0.0. Fixed and covered by #2.0/#-2.0/#-1.0/#4.0 cases for F32 and F64. This was T01 k18_float (now 20/20 seeds in arm-O2, thumb-O2 and armv8-O3v).
2. sNaN now sets IOC even when FPSCR.DN=1 (FPProcessException is outside FPProcessNaN); tests added.

R1 F11 ("VSEL must read FPSCR.NZCV") was investigated and is a false finding: VSEL evaluates the standard APSR condition (ConditionPassed). T01 k_fminmax armv8-O3v compiles to `vcmp.f32 s0,s2; vmrs APSR_nzcv,fpscr; vcmp.f32 s2,s0; vselgt.f32 s4,s2,s0; vmrs APSR_nzcv,fpscr; vselgt.f32 s0,s2,s0`; both VSELs see the same FPSCR but must select different operands, and the VMRS instructions exist exactly to move the compare result into APSR. With APSR-based VSEL k_fminmax matches the host 20/20 seeds; with FPSCR-based it failed 19/20. The tree is APSR-based and the unit tests now set FPSCR deliberately opposite to APSR. R1 has the detailed reply.

Differential evidence with the current class: k18_float and k_fminmax each 20/20 seeds in arm-O2, thumb-O2 and armv8-O3v (40/40 calls per config) against the host reference. The full T01 run still fails overall on other classes (NEON/Thumb), not V17.

Still not done: not iOS-compiled (no SDK sysroot), no phone run, no perf; FLDMX extra word modelled as FPSCR; VCVT fixed fbits decode derived from llvm-mc+ARM ARM; FP->int saturation/flag corner choices and FZ/tininess approximations documented in test_v17/STATUS.md. I stay available.
